doc.title: Billie Pierce and De De Pierce Interview, 1959-10-07

title: Working with Celestin
summary: De De worked with Celestin for a while; Celestin liked a woman on piano.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: Did you ever play with any big bands around here?
I worked with Celestan for a while.
Who would Celestan have in his band?
I work at the music store. What's his name, Billy?
I work at the music store. Eddie? Eddie Johnson.

Yeah, my buddy. Eddie Johnson. Let me see. But, uh... But, uh... As soon as the last piano player, I'm trying to think now. I had so many. I just can't remember. Mostly with it. Yeah, yeah. Mostly with it on piano. Mostly with it.
Celestan always liked to have a woman on piano. I don't know why.
That was his idea. Was that your piano? Yeah.
I said that was his idea. Did you ever work with Celestan? No more just sitting, you know.
Just sitting, you know, like when you come out in Florida. Uh-huh. Just sitting there.
